  def some_function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5) do
    [1, 2, 3]

origin: it should NOT report when part of a larger pipeline using Enum.count/2
source:
defmodule Credo.Sample.Module do
  def some_function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5) do
    [1, 2, 3]
    |> Enum.sort()
    |> Enum.filter(fn x -> rem(x, 3) == 0 end)
    |> Enum.count(fn x -> x > 2 end)
    |> then(fn x -> x + 1 end)
  end
end
